full_judgment: 57. The Appellate Division decision in Sharping M.S. Samity-v-Bangladesh , supra, reflects the legal position described in situation (1) ante. This situation contemplates an action taken by the government in it's capacity as the sovereign in demising hat, bazar, fisheries khas lands and the like.
